responsibility: This file implements the BPF target’s CO-RE metadata construction and .BTF.ext emission logic. It belongs to the backend/debug-info boundary for eBPF and owns the in-memory representation of CO-RE relocation records grouped by ELF section, the helper that turns a preserved-access-index path into a BTF type id plus colon-separated access string, lookup of a field’s struct/union member index from CTF/BTF type information, and the final assembly output of the .BTF.ext header and per-section relocation records that reference instruction labels to be patched by the loader. In effect, it consumes frontend/type metadata, CTF/BTF string/type tables, section names, accessor paths, and RTL labels, and produces the serialized CO-RE relocation subsection of the emitted object file for loader-side kernel-structure adjustment.
same_name_distinction: Unlike the same-stem header gcc/config/bpf/coreout.h, this source file contains the executable implementation of BPF CO-RE support: it builds per-ELF-section relocation state, computes access-string and member-index metadata from CTF/BTF information, and emits the serialized .BTF.ext CO-RE records. The header only defines the shared .BTF.ext/relocation layouts, enums, and function declarations used by this implementation.
